note: Synthetic, rights-cleared corpus written for this benchmark. Every provider, document and URL is invented; none of it is real provider output and no case asserts anything about the real world. A provider returns a document when every one of that document's terms appears in the question it is asked. The federation deliberately does NOT model relevance ranking or result truncation, so this corpus cannot and does not demonstrate a recall gain from decomposition.
